text.id: Sebelum nelpon Bima, gue turun ke tangga. Duduk di anak tangga yang paling bunyi.
text.en: Before I call Bima, I go out to the stairs. I sit on the step that creaks the loudest.

text.id: Voice note dua puluh detik itu masih di sana, di bawah semua draf. Gue bilang nanti, kalau udah siap. Gue nggak bakal pernah siap.
text.en: The twenty-second voice note is still there, under all the drafts. I said I'd listen later, when I was ready. I'm never going to be ready.

text.id: Ka. Ini konyol, gue ngomong ke HP yang nggak bakal ngirim apa-apa. Tapi gue butuh ngomong ke seseorang yang bukan Tasya, bukan Bima.
text.en: Ka. This is stupid, talking to a phone that won't send anything. But I need to talk to someone who isn't Tasya, isn't Bima.

text.id: Gue nemu sesuatu. Sesuatu yang gede. Dan gue rasa ada yang ngebocorin kalau gue punya itu.{w} Kalau gue ngilang, lo tahu harus mulai dari mana.
text.en: I found something. Something big. And I think someone leaked that I have it.{w} If I disappear, you'll know where to start.

text.id: "Bukan Tasya, bukan Bima." Dia ngomong ke gue karena gue satu-satunya orang yang nggak ada di sekitar dia.
text.en: "Isn't Tasya, isn't Bima." She talked to me because I was the one person who wasn't around her.

text.id: "Ada yang ngebocorin." Gue naik lagi ke kamar.
text.en: "Someone leaked it." I go back up to her room.
